business_summary.text: Integrated PropTech platform operating Housing.com, NestAway, HelloWorld, Aurum Analytica, Sell.do and PropTiger across the Indian real estate lifecycle.

call_points.text: No numeric FY27 revenue or margin guidance; focus is on improving financial metrics each quarter.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterates the no-guidance stance from the April call

call_points.text: About ₹120 Cr of costs cut at Housing.com within the first week of acquisition.
Distribution sold 117,000 leads, up 79% YoY, with 10,560 active technology licenses and ₹838 Cr of home sales facilitated.
call_points.versus_prior: leads up from the 1.7 lakh+ sold in Q2FY27 per memory

call_points.text: Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 840 bps to 11.5%; PBT margin improved 1,270 bps to 4.8%.
Rental segment turned profitable at ₹0.9 Cr against a ₹4.3 Cr loss a year ago; beds to grow again after consolidation.
call_points.versus_prior: delivers the FY27 rental profitability expected in April

call_points.text: Housing.com came with ₹1,020 Cr of carryforward losses; management says it is too early to say how much can be set off.
No inorganic acquisitions planned in the short run; management bandwidth is on the Housing.com integration.
Revenue per team member is around ₹50 lakh-plus, targeted at ₹56 lakh by year-end.
Rental platform scaled to 8,500+ rentable units across 4,300 houses.
Sell.do achieved ₹1.7 Cr in new sales, with 125 closures adding 980 licenses.
No specific FY27 revenue or margin guidance; reiterates focus on profitable growth and disciplined execution
call_points.versus_prior: reiterates the no-guidance stance from the Q4FY26 call

call_points.text: No numeric FY27 revenue or margin guidance; management cites a 40% YoY growth track record and expects a similar trajectory.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterates the no-guidance stance from the Q4FY26 call

call_points.text: Distribution segment has delivered 22% to 25% margins across its companies.
Rental segment profitability expected in FY27; HelloWorld reached adjusted EBITDA break-even in the current month.
Aurum Analytica sold over 1,48,000 leads in Q4 FY26, up 93% YoY, to 145 active clients across 275 signed projects.
Sell.do ended Q4 with 916 active accounts, up 38% YoY, and 10,378 active licenses, up 32%.
NestAway at ~9,600 rentable units across 5,214 houses; house count cut in a portfolio rationalisation, revenue up via value-added services.
SM REIT focused on commercial pre-leased Grade A assets; management intends to launch one in FY27.
Cross-sell revenue still in single digits; management to track ecosystem revenue this year.
IT hiring slowdown hits rental demand in BPO-heavy cities like Pune; management counters with a 'Win a Pin Code' concentration strategy.
No further acquisitions planned; management says it has not found anything compelling and will grow existing lines organically.
No FY27 revenue or margin guidance; the deck gives only FY26-27 AI-led efficiency targets.
Sells Navi Mumbai Buildings Q5 and Q6 for ₹112 Cr; proceeds to retire debt and fund reinvestment.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹123.85 Cr (+75.9% YoY), net profit ₹16.44 Cr (against a loss of ₹9.87 Cr a year earlier).
2026-04-26: Q4FY26 investor presentation — total income ₹134.59 Cr (+72% YoY), PBT ₹3.41 Cr before exceptional items, and a ₹112 Cr Navi Mumbai building sale announced.
Aurum PropTech Limited shared Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call recording on April 27, 2026, available on its website.

2026-04-30: Q4FY26 earnings call transcript — revenue from continuing operations ₹123.85 Cr (+10.2% QoQ), second consecutive profitable quarter, distribution segment ~60% of total income; Q5/Q6 building sale to make the company debt-free by 30 June 2026.
Aurum PropTech filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹37.57 Cr unutilised rights issue proceeds.
2026-05-21: Aurum PropTech completed the sale of Buildings Q5 and Q6 in Navi Mumbai for ₹112 Cr, fully prepaid its LRD facility and said it is debt-free.
2026-06-05: Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited filed its Regulation 31(4) disclosure for FY26 — promoter group holds 3,64,89,367 shares with no encumbrance during the year.

Q1FY27: Aurum PropTech reports third consecutive profitable quarter with 71% YoY revenue growth to ₹111.84 Cr; announces Housing.com acquisition to create India's largest AI-native real estate operating system.

2026-10-13: Aurum PropTech allotted 51,00,000 fully convertible warrants to promoter Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited at ₹231.421 each, ₹118.02 Cr in all, with ₹29.51 Cr (25%) received on allotment.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹130.19 Cr (+57.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4.51 Cr (against a loss of ₹8.56 Cr a year earlier).
Aurum PropTech released its Q2 FY2027 investor presentation showing total income of ₹137.31 Cr (+57% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of ₹15.44 Cr.
Aurum PropTech Limited shared Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings call recording on October 16, 2026, via its website.
Aurum PropTech's Q2FY27 earnings call (Oct 16, 2026) set a Housing.com breakeven target of 4-6 quarters after a ₹120 Cr cost cut, and flagged a ₹2,400 Cr KuberX loan run rate.
